name: Resist Arcana (dispelling)
body:
School abjuration; Level alchemist 5, cleric/oracle 5, inquisitor 5, sorcerer/wizard 6, summoner 6

EFFECT

Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)
Target Restrictions selected

DESCRIPTION

The target of a wordspell with this effect word gains spell resistance equal to 12 + the caster’s level.
